reproducibility_gaps: The representative example imports PhysicsNeMo-Sym, but its README delegates installation to the separate PhysicsNeMo-Sym repository and does not pin an exact compatible version in the example directory.
The training entrypoint reports no random seed or deterministic-algorithm setting.
GPU-oriented framework/container context is documented, but the representative run's original hardware, CUDA driver and resource requirements are not specified.
The workflow writes field plots but provides no bundled reference result, numerical metric or acceptance threshold.
No reusable trained checkpoint is identified for the representative workflow.
The heterogeneous framework tree was intentionally bounded to one directly extractable PINN example; other workflows were not individually normalized or executed.
notes: R3: the pinned source, locked root environment, installation surfaces, dataset-free entrypoint, model configuration, physics losses, sampling, training loop and output path substantially define the assessed workflow. Missing deterministic controls, example-local dependency compatibility and quantitative expected results block R4.
